    Cokernels on a periodic star model spanned by one row (Appendix B) #

    characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex: "We will show that each periodic component contributes at most one correction line, represented by a single path." On a periodic star model, the twisted-trace surjection of Lemma A.2 (rowClass_mem_span) sends words at the centre onto the row classes. If every twisted trace of a word in an allowed degree is an integer multiple of the trace of one word W₀, then all cokernel classes are multiples of the class of the row given by W₀ at the centre (star_span_deg). This is the analogue of star_surjective_deg with a spanning word instead of vanishing traces.
